title: One-time payments in Checkout Sessions support no-cost orders
summary: No-cost orders are now enabled for one-time payments in Checkout Sessions, changing the value of payment_method_collection from always to if_required.
migrationNotes: This change simplifies the checkout process for free items or zero-cost transactions, potentially reducing friction for scenarios like free trials or promotional offerings.

sources.quote: | [One-time payments in Checkout Sessions support no-cost orders](https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/2023-08-16/no-cost-orders-checkout-session.md) | Checkout | Breaking | api |

[No-cost orders](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout/no-cost-orders.md) are now enabled for one-time payments in Checkout Sessions, changing the value of `payment_method_collection` from `always` to `if_required`.
